keyEvents.text: Goal! Brentford 1, Arsenal 0. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mikkel Damsgaard following a fast break.
Jurriën Timber (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Christian Nørgaard (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brentford 1, Arsenal 1. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! Brentford 1, Arsenal 2. Mikel Merino (Arsenal) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Goal! Brentford 1, Arsenal 3. Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brentford. Paris Maghoma replaces Mikkel Damsgaard.
Substitution, Brentford. Kevin Schade replaces Yoane Wissa.
Substitution, Brentford. Kim Ji-Soo replaces Sepp van den Berg.
Substitution, Brentford. Mathias Jensen replaces Christian Nørgaard.
Substitution, Arsenal. Myles Lewis-Skelly replaces Riccardo Calafiori.
Substitution, Arsenal. Leandro Trossard replaces Ethan Nwaneri.
Substitution, Arsenal. Declan Rice replaces Mikel Merino.
Substitution, Arsenal. Jorginho replaces Martin Ødegaard.
Substitution, Arsenal. Oleksandr Zinchenko replaces Gabriel Jesus.
